channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Leslie Alexander | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Leslie Alexander from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander, Tilman Fertitta
item.description:
Mark Berman:Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander selling to @Tilman Fertitta:

“(Les has)been a great owner. I think he passes the ball to the right player”

Hakeem Olajuwon on Leslie Alexander, Tilman Fertitta, Sep 5, 2017. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: James Harden on Leslie Alexander, Tad Brown
item.description:
“It was probably one of the toughest decisions of my life, just to not go to Rio, but ... I wanted to make a conscious effort to be here and be with Daryl and Mr. Alexander and Tad Brown on who we can get in this locker room to help me for this upcoming season,”

James Harden on Leslie Alexander, Tad Brown, Jan 4, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: James Harden on Leslie Alexander
item.description:
James Harden:

“Dear Red Nation: Saturday was a big day for all of us who love the Rockets. I feel so honored to be able to extend my basketball career in this great City which I now call home. I can't thank Mr. Alexander enough for the faith he has shown in me and the incredible support my family and I feel from the organization and our fans. From the first day I arrived you embraced me as your own. Your support has helped me grow so much as a player and as a man - from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!”

James Harden on Leslie Alexander, Jul 11, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Leslie Alexander
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni on going to work for Leslie Alexander:

“Terrific. He's been voted a few times the best owner in the NBA. He continues to be that.”

Mike D'Antoni on Leslie Alexander, May 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Tad Brown on Leslie Alexander
item.description:
“Certainly when Moses passed away Leslie and I had a conversation immediately about just how tragic and how fleeting everything is, and we wanted to make sure we were doing what we could to help,”

Tad Brown on Leslie Alexander, Dec 23, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.
